name: SO-101 (LeRobot)
summary: Printed desk arm with six Feetech STS3215 bus servos. Comes as a leader and follower pair, so you can teach it by moving the leader arm, then train it with Hugging Face LeRobot.

name: Thor
summary: Fully 3D-printable 6-axis arm driven by stepper motors, with an open-source controller and GUI.

name: PAROL6
summary: Desktop arm built like a small industrial robot: steppers with gearboxes, printed parts, its own control board and commander software.

name: AR4 (Annin Robotics)
summary: Larger 6-axis arm with steppers, aluminium and printed parts, a Teensy controller and a ROS 2 driver. Sold as kits or plans.

name: BCN3D Moveo
summary: 5-axis printable arm made for schools, with NEMA 17 steppers and the Arduino-based electronics used in many 3D printers.

name: Arduino SCARA robot (How To Mechatronics)
summary: Step-by-step SCARA build with NEMA 17 steppers, belts, printed parts and an Arduino, with a full video walkthrough.

name: Awesome plotters (open-source pen plotters)
summary: A curated list of open-source pen plotter and drawing machine builds, software and communities. Most are a small XYZ gantry with two steppers and a servo pen lift.

name: Delta X S
summary: Open-source delta robot for makers, built for fast pick and place of light objects, with its own controller and software.
